metaDescription: Learn about Calculaderia: free and open-source tools for financial calculations. Find out who created it and what is the project's mission.
title: About Calculaderia
intro: Calculaderia is an open-source project created to help people make more informed financial decisions.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: Democratize access to quality financial tools. We believe everyone should have free access to accurate calculators to understand mortgages, investments and compare options before making important decisions.

creator.title: Who Created It
creator.text: Calculaderia was created by Saulo Faria, a software engineer passionate about building tools that help people. The project was born from frustration with confusing, inaccurate or ad-filled online financial calculators.

openSource.title: Open Source
openSource.text: All of Calculaderia's code is available on GitHub. This means you can see exactly how the calculations are made, suggest improvements or even contribute new features.

methodology.title: Methodology
methodology.text: We use standard market financial formulas. For mortgages, we implement SAC and Price systems as practiced by Brazilian banks. For investments, we consider taxation (income tax, IOF) and inflation when applicable.
